files.caption: Three photographs of 1416 Winona Drive, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are dated circa 1945. The real estate listing for 1416 Winona Drive reads: Two White Cottages. Situated on a nice level lot, both in excellent condition and modern. Two-car garage and side drive. Some shade trees, good neighborhood. Further details on call.
